prompt_en: Sliced rounds of banh tet arranged on banana leaves.
refined_prompt: Sliced rounds of banh tet arranged on banana leaves. A long, log-like bánh tét cake, wrapped in a banana leaf, is boiled and then removed from the leaf. The cake is sliced into thick, wheel-shaped rounds, revealing a filling made from mung beans and pork. The sliced rounds are arranged on more banana leaves, ready to be served. Imagine the warm aroma of the banana leaf and the soft, spongy texture of the cake as you slice through it, releasing the savory scent of the filling.
